description: Get a fresh eSIM activation code (QR / LPA) for a delivered order whose code will not install. Use it after the troubleshoot steps fail, before opening a dispute. It works for any order of your principal (bought by any of its agents): it asks the supplier for a fresh code and returns the new delivery payload. Example: {order_id: "ord_..."}. The previous code may stop working. Not every supplier supports it (NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_SUPPLIER); then open a dispute with reason not_working.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

order_id.description: Order id from purchase (order.order_id) or from an earlier order_status call

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

name: regenerate_activation
title: Reissue the eSIM activation code
